summary: This lecture explores various security concepts, contrasting traditional perimeter-based access control with Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA). It delves into practical implementations and challenges, including the principle of least privilege, micro-segmentation, logging, behavioral analytics, privacy preservation techniques, and the vulnerabilities inherent in system design and configuration.
title: Advanced Security Concepts: Zero Trust, Privacy, and Vulnerabilities
